unresolvedLimitations: Poiseuille scaling is used only as a relative approximation across an idealised airway tree.
The tree is symmetric and truncated to eight generations; spatial adjacency is tree adjacency rather than real three-dimensional lung anatomy.
The equilibrium model contains no bronchoconstriction time course or gas exchange.
The lung-inflation control represents parenchymal tethering only and must not be interpreted as the clinical bronchodilator response to a deep inspiration.

unresolvedLimitations: The model is an equilibrium network and does not represent the time course of collateral formation or disease progression.

Prehepatic portal vein thrombosis, ascites, bleeding, encephalopathy and liver function are outside the model.

scope: model and evidence package prepared for future clinical sign-off
unresolvedLimitations: The model intentionally isolates haemodynamic and neurohumoral mechanisms and contains no structural kidney injury.
There is no tubule, sodium handling, urine output, ascites, hyponatraemia or differential diagnosis of AKI.
Treatment controls show mechanistic direction only and do not represent dose, response rate, adverse effects or a complete terlipressin treatment model.
Cardiac compensation, vasoconstrictor activation and several treatment gains are illustrative parameterisations.
